title: Pacsea: Find and review Arch packages

production.interface: Complete 116-column, 34-row native Ratatui TestBackend buffers exported as SVG. The terminal title bar and cursor treatment are recreated. Preflight is enabled for this demonstration.
production.fixtures: Package inventories, versions, configured repository, build recipe, check results, comments, vote state, history, export path and transaction sizes are illustrative. Copy used a private file-backed clipboard. No checker, vote, live API or package transaction ran.
production.render: From this folder run t3-build python render.py /path/to/explainer-video. The sibling 01-discovery-pilot supplies the shared terminal captures and Quiet Index score.
